svg.aria-label: Stripe ↔ Salesforce: Card payments close the right NPSP donation, and donors get the right thank-you email automatically. A backstop matches each payment by Stripe ID, then recurring donation, then email and amount. An LWC console switches each of 13 email types between Live, Test and Off.
